thread:
Maya Chen: Quick heads-up — just finished onboarding call with Greencore. They love the demo but hit three repeat pain points and one wishlist. Capturing here to hand off to product/eng.

Maya Chen: Painpoints: 1) CSV import failing on a small subset of customer files (parsing error). 2) Admins can't see per-route cost breakdown which is blocking billing validation. 3) Webhooks delayed 30–90s intermittently. Wishlist: per-user token throttles for seat-level controls.

Arjun Patel: thanks Maya. can you drop the notes + sample file? I want to triage for priority.

Maya Chen: pasted notes + sample: https://drive.redwood.example/greencore-onboard (internal). sample csv snippet:```email,org,route
joe@greencore.com,Greencore,default
"Bob, Jr",Greencore,priority``` causing `CSVParseError: unmatched quote at line 2`

Jules Rivera: I'll take the CSV importer. that quoted-name edgecase should be caught by our parser — seems like we don't support RFC4180 multiline/quoted fields in the current path. ETA 3 dev days + QA.

Liam O'Connor: I'll own webhooks. initial guess: worker backlog + retry backoff is too aggressive. will check queue metrics, ETA 1 day for root cause.

Arjun Patel: PM triage: recommend priority order — CSV importer (P0/P1 because it blocks onboarding), Webhooks (P1 reliability), Per-route cost visibility (P2: important for billing but has workaround). Per-user throttles as a backlog feature (P3).

Maya Chen: greencore's onboarding timeline: wants imports clean by next Tue or they delay pilot. they're flexible on cost UI but need assurances on accuracy. I'll push for CSV fix first.

Samira (triage-bot): Created ticket INT-4523 CSV-importer-quoted-fields assigned to Jules Rivera.

Jules Rivera: noted INT-4523. I'll add repro, link sample file, and a small migration plan to avoid regressions. ps — should we include a quick fix in API layer to sanitize quotes for now?

Arjun Patel: good call. quick sanitization middleware as a stopgap (toggleable) — low risk. Jules + Liam, sync on whether the middleware affects webhook payloads? probably not but confirm.

Liam O'Connor: confirmed — middleware for CSV parsing lives in upload path, won't touch webhooks.

Maya Chen: action items: 1) Jules — INT-4523, quick sanitization + full parser fix (3d). 2) Liam — investigate webhooks queue + mitigation (1d). 3) Arjun — prioritize and draft release note & customer message. 4) Maya — follow Greencore, confirm acceptance criteria and timeline.

Arjun Patel: I'll add a short customer-facing note template and add items to the roadmap board: https://boards.redwood.example/onboard-triage

Maya Chen: thanks team :thumbsup: I'll update the customer and set expectation for Tue.

Jules Rivera: starting on repro now, will ping when INT-4523 has a PR.

Liam O'Connor: looking at queue now, will share metrics in this thread.

Maya Chen: perfect — keeping this thread as canonical handoff. if anyone needs me to loop in solutions eng for a joint call, ping me.

Arjun Patel: assign owners in the tracker and mark ETA.

Samira (triage-bot): INT-4523 status: triaged -> in_progress.

Maya Chen: summary for CS notes: Greencore onboard blocked by CSV import; priority fix committed to engineering pipeline; monitor webhooks; CS to confirm acceptance once CSV uploads succeed.

Jules Rivera: ACK.

Liam O'Connor: ACK.
